entities.name: Maria Śliwka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Śliwka was a Polish volleyball player. She was a member of Poland women's national volleyball team in 1957–1964, a bronze medalist of the Olympic Games Tokyo 1964, a bronze medalist of the World Championship 1962 and medalist of the European Championship.
